title.zh: 为阿布拉省增设两名助理省检察官，为此修订《行政法典》第1674条（经修正）的法案
title.en: An Act Providing Two Additional Assistant Provincial Fiscals for the Province of Abra, Amending for the Purpose Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administrative Code, as Amended
title.orig: An Act Providing Two Additional Assistant Provincial Fiscals for the Province of Abra, Amending for the Purpose Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administrative Code, as Amended

text.en:
Section sixteen hundred seventy-four of the Administrative Code, as amended, relative to the number of assistant provincial fiscals in the Province of Abra, is further amended to read as follows:
"Abra, three assistant provincial fiscals;"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 4, 1969.
